message.mistinn.bell.rest: You rest by the golden bell. Its toll remembers you.
message.mistinn.bell.rest_once: You rest by the one-time bell. It can call you back only once.
message.mistinn.bell.returned: The bell's echo calls you back.
message.mistinn.bell.cracked: The one-time bell cracked after calling you back.
message.mistinn.bell.gone: The bell you rested at is gone.
message.mistinn.residue.recovered: You take back %s salt from the residue.
item.mistinn.helmet_n.lore.1: Sewn from scrap sails and rusted hide.
item.mistinn.helmet_n.lore.2: Keeps off the mist, not the blade.
item.mistinn.helmet_1.lore.1: A Rust Anchor porter's helm, more rivets than padding.
item.mistinn.helmet_1.lore.2: Wear it long and you hear the cranes.
item.mistinn.helmet_2.lore.1: Worn by the tide patrol along the ebb line.
item.mistinn.helmet_2.lore.2: Its fin parts the sea mist, a little.
item.mistinn.helmet_3.lore.1: The station guard's helm, an anchor cast on the brow.
item.mistinn.helmet_3.lore.2: Given only to those who held three tides.
item.mistinn.helmet_4.lore.1: Mist-glass in the visor shows shapes in thick fog.
item.mistinn.helmet_4.lore.2: Mistwalkers say seeing too clearly costs too.
item.mistinn.helmet_5.lore.1: Cast after the golden bells; it hums when still.
item.mistinn.helmet_5.lore.2: Only those who understand the toll can bear it.
item.mistinn.helmet_6.lore.1: A skull from deep in the zone, crusted with rust and salt.
item.mistinn.helmet_6.lore.2: Its wearer dreams of tides running backwards.
item.mistinn.armor_n.lore.1: Layers of rusted hide tied with rope.
item.mistinn.armor_n.lore.2: Better than nothing: a hunter's first coat.
item.mistinn.armor_1.lore.1: A porter's iron-strip vest. Takes knocks, not cuts.
item.mistinn.armor_1.lore.2: Just heavy enough to remind you you're standing.
item.mistinn.armor_2.lore.1: Salt-cured leather with sea glass set in the chest.
item.mistinn.armor_2.lore.2: Unafraid of the tide, and hardly of the blade.
item.mistinn.armor_3.lore.1: Station guard plate with a gilded anchor badge.
item.mistinn.armor_3.lore.2: Wear it and you are a wall of the station.
item.mistinn.armor_4.lore.1: Heavy plate; its mist-crystal belt spreads a blow.
item.mistinn.armor_4.lore.2: Slows you down, and keeps you alive longer.
item.mistinn.armor_5.lore.1: Forged of a metal the border world lacks, like the bells.
item.mistinn.armor_5.lore.2: When struck, it rings very softly.
item.mistinn.armor_6.lore.1: Bone scales overlapping; no one knows whose they were.
item.mistinn.armor_6.lore.2: It remembers the zone's paths better than you.
item.mistinn.backpack_n.lore.1: A sack tied shut with a rusted buckle.
item.mistinn.backpack_n.lore.2: Holds a day's food and a little luck.
item.mistinn.backpack_1.lore.1: A porter's canvas bag: hard-wearing, not picky.
item.mistinn.backpack_1.lore.2: The most common pack at Rust Anchor.
item.mistinn.backpack_2.lore.1: The tide patrol's long pack, made for climbing reefs.
item.mistinn.backpack_2.lore.2: Its bottom is lined with waterproof salt cloth.
item.mistinn.backpack_3.lore.1: Three compartments: food, ammunition, odds and ends.
item.mistinn.backpack_3.lore.2: Anchorguards say the untidy don't survive two tides.
item.mistinn.backpack_4.lore.1: A large climbing pack for long trips into the zone.
item.mistinn.backpack_4.lore.2: A knot for the way back is tied to its strap.
item.mistinn.backpack_5.lore.1: A metal load frame bellkeepers use to carry bell shards.
item.mistinn.backpack_5.lore.2: Heavy, but it brings the whole haul home.
item.mistinn.backpack_6.lore.1: A huge bone-framed case, roomier inside than out.
item.mistinn.backpack_6.lore.2: No one knows where its first bearer went.
